leadRow.title: Cooling failure disrupts multiple Google Cloud services in one European zone

evidence.sourceTitle: RESOLVED: Google Cloud VMware Engine (GCVE), Google Cloud NetApp Volumes, and Bare Metal Solutions (BMS) services are experiencing a service outage in europe-west4-a due to a cooling failure.
evidence.significance: A physical cooling failure affected VMware, storage and bare-metal services together. Resilience owners should test whether zone design, recovery priorities and customer-impact evidence reflect correlated infrastructure failures rather than assuming service independence.

leadRow.title: Physical cooling failure takes multiple Google Cloud services offline

evidence.sourceTitle: RESOLVED: Google Cloud VMware Engine (GCVE), Google Cloud NetApp Volumes, and Bare Metal Solutions (BMS) services are experiencing a service outage in europe-west4-a due to a cooling failure.
evidence.significance: The incident is a reminder that cloud failures can begin below the software layer and affect several services together. Technology owners should test zonal failover, data recovery and restoration sequencing against correlated physical-infrastructure loss.
